title: SPLA/69/2010 of R.K.SHARMA Vs LAXMI ASOOCIATE THROUGH PARTNER M.L.AHUJA AND ORS

paras.text:
SPLA No.69 of 2010
With
CRLA No.243 of 2010
Hon'ble Dharam Veer, J.
Heard Mr. Manish Arora, Advocate for the applicant.
I have perused the judgment and order dated 14.9.2010
passed by Special Judicial Magistrate, C.B.I., Dehradun in
Complaint Case No.239 of 2010.
Leave to appeal is granted.
Admit the appeal.
Issue notice to respondent nos.1, 2 and 3.
Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that respondent
no.4 Smt. Laxmi Devi (Bai) has died and therefore he seeks
permission to delete the name of respondent no.4 from the array of
parties.
Permission is granted.
Let the name of respondent no.4 Smt. Laxmi Devi be deleted
from the array of parties, during the course of day.
 (D.V.,J.)
 20.10.2010
RG
